             October 12, 2026 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Sub: Audio recording of earnings call 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Further to our submission dated October 12, 2026 on Press Release and Investor 
Presentation and pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46(2) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended (“SEBI Listing Regulations”), we 
wish to inform you that the audio recording of the earnings call with analysts and investors 
held on October 12, 2026 on the unaudited financial results of the Bank for the quarter and 
half year ended September 30, 2026, is made available on the website of the Bank at 
https://www.rbl.bank.in/investor-relations/disclosures-regulation-46/financial-highlights.  
 
Pursuant to the aforesaid SEBI Listing Regulations, the transcript of the earnings call with 
analysts and investors held on October 12, 2026, on the unaudited financial results of the 
Bank for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, shall also be made available 
on the website of the Bank at https://www.rbl.bank.in/. 
 
Kindly take the same on record. 
 
Thanking you. 
 
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
 
For RBL Bank Limited 
 
 
 
 
Niti Arya
